title.label: Instagram becomes more enjoyable, less harmful

content.label: Instagram reels to me can feel like getting sucked into a black hole where i lose my grip on reality and can’t stop scrolling. Having one sec interventions makes me aware of my surroundings every 5 minutes meaning i can enjoy the funny videos on Instagram without missing out on my day. I use apple’s screen time feature as well to limit Instagram to an hour per day and I have someone else who knows the screen time password. This means I can only do ‘one more minute’ once when the time runs out. I feel like I am in control of my time now. I like the features one sec has especially the new scrolling wheel to choose the amount of time you want before an intervention which is way more purposeful than before when you hit a button to choose the time. This app is very helpful to my life.

With the introduction of the re-intervention, this app is now perfect. It allows you to still receive notifications from the app you are blocking (e.g. in case someone messages you on Instagram) but delays you from opening the app and kicks you out after some time.

There is no other free app that does all 3 of the above that I have found.

I have previously used Screen Time to help me not look at my phone as much, but have run into frustrations with its all or nothing approach. One Sec is the middle ground I’ve been looking for as it provides lots of ways to discourage me from opening apps. Making it annoying (in a beneficial way) without making it utterly impossible is the best way for me I think.

The only things it’s missing for me are

1) the ability to hide the settings menu behind a long intervention to prevent the temptation of changing settings to get around the limits
2) some way to auto generate the shortcuts needed to make the app function

Great work!

And tbh I really like having the number of times you tried opening an app because I kinda want to do a little competition with myself. Like how many hours can I go without attempting to open the app

Also I now get an annoying additional pop up every time I open or close an app asking “what’s your intention” then a list of apps for me to choose from. It’s just another irritating thing that is unnecessary. I can’t find any way to turn it off. 

I emailed support before the new year and had an initial response asking for more detail but then heard nothing. 

I’m still using it but it’s kinda broken right now.
